Sprint 13 — InkOS Flash & Portfolio Page rebuild. You design the **public-facing** pages.

**Project:** /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS
**Approved plan:** /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/deep-check-page-and-effervescent-babbage.md — read sections 4.2, 6, 7, 8 carefully.
**Brand Board (LOCKED):** ./CLAUDE.md §4 — four colors only (Bone #F7F7F5, Onyx #0F0F0F, Stone #787774, Rust #B23A2B), Inter + Instrument Serif + JetBrains Mono only, four brand rules, no Tailwind default shadows.
**Schema (shipped):** `supabase/migrations/20260428100000_s13_flash_inventory.sql`

## Your scope — public pages ONLY

These four routes, no auth, anonymous Supabase client, must work mobile-perfect:

1. `/p/[studioSlug]` — studio portfolio landing. Featured pieces grid (mixed flash + portfolio). Studio header (logo, name, location, artist count, "Book now" CTA → existing `/book/[studioSlug]`).
2. `/p/[studioSlug]/[artistSlug]` — per-artist public profile. Tabs: **Flash** (inventory) / **Portfolio** (healed work). PDF audit calls this out as the deliverable: a public website each artist actually wants to share.
3. `/p/[studioSlug]/flash/[pieceId]` — single flash piece. Hero image (watermarked), price (Inter 800 tabular Onyx), status badge, 1/1 badge if applicable, **Reserve** primary CTA → POSTs to `/api/flash/[id]/reserve`. Second tab: see other work by this artist.
4. `/p/[studioSlug]/sheet/[sheetSlug]` — sheet (drop) detail. Editorial cover hero, drop date, all pieces in grid with status badges. "Spring Drop 2026" feel.

Plus the layout: `app/p/layout.tsx` — minimal chrome (brand mark only top-left, no sidebar, no auth nav), mobile-first, dark/light theme respect.

## Deliverable

ONE markdown file at:
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/docs/sprint-13-public-pages-design.md`

Per-route structured JSON-ish spec Koda can build directly from. Include for EACH route:

- **Route + file path** (App Router).
- **Data fetched** (Supabase query, anonymous client).
- **SEO metadata** (title, description, OG image strategy — for `/p/[studio]/flash/[pieceId]` use the watermarked image).
- **Section composition** (top→bottom). For each section: copy slot + visual notes (token names only, no hex literals — reference globals.css).
- **CTA destinations**.
- **Empty states** (artist with no flash, sheet with no pieces, etc).
- **Mobile breakpoints** — what stacks, what hides.
- **Performance notes** — `revalidate`, image priority, LCP target <2.0s.

Plus a global section:
- **Public layout** spec (`app/p/layout.tsx`).
- **Brand-mark-in-header** sizing per Brand Board §4.3 (24px tile + wordmark, no subtitle).
- **Footer** for public pages — minimal: "Powered by InkOS" + studio's own contact info.
- **Reserve button states** (idle / loading / disabled if status≠available / success redirect).
- **Cookie/consent** — anonymous tracking only, no PostHog identify until reservation form submitted.

## Constraints — REJECT YOUR OWN DRAFT IF:

- Any color outside the four brand tokens.
- Any default Tailwind shadow.
- Italic on body or labels (only on page titles + accent words).
- Multiple Rust accents per viewport.
- Generic SaaS imagery / illustrations / shrug emojis.
- Confetti, gradient backgrounds, frosted glass.
- Chrome that feels like it's an embedded studio backend (it must feel like an editorial brand site).

## Voice (Quill aligned)

- Editorial. Quiet. No exclamation marks.
- Empty states: serif name + 1-sentence editorial copy.
- Reserve button copy: **Reserve** (not "Buy now", not "Add to cart", not "Click here").
- Reserve confirmation: *"Reserved. We'll email you to lock the chair."*

## Process

1. Read plan file, ./CLAUDE.md §4 (Brand v1.0), ./CLAUDE.md §6 (Voice), and the migration file (so you know exactly what fields exist).
2. Look at existing booking flow for parallel — `app/book/[studioSlug]/page.tsx` and `app/book/[studioSlug]/artist/[artistSlug]/page.tsx`. The new public pages should feel cousin-of-booking, not stranger-of-booking. Borrow patterns.
3. Look at `app/globals.css` `@theme inline` to confirm available tokens (especially `text-page-title`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-card-hover`, `shadow-soft-md`, the four colors).
4. Write the spec.

## Output format
Markdown. Use H2 per route. JSON-ish blocks for component composition (Koda parses these). Tabular for breakpoints. End with a "Handoff to Koda" checklist of files to create.

DO NOT write code or TSX. Spec only. Vega will review specs from you + Elio together before Koda starts.
